title: The Late Night Murder
story:
In the small, quiet town of Ashville, our detective received an anonymous tip about a fatal murder at the local library. On arriving at the scene, they discovered Mr. Jameson, the town librarian, brutally killed in the reading section.

Crime Scene: The dimly lit library was filled with stacks of books, a broken vase, and shattered glass suggesting a violent struggle.

Victim: Mr. Jameson, the 50-year-old town librarian.

Testimonies:
1. Miss Adams, the old lady: 'I heard a loud noise around midnight, while searching for a rare book.' She left the library shortly after and didn't see anyone.
2. Mrs. Wilson, the book club organizer: 'At the meeting last night, Mr. Jameson argued with someone over a disputed book.' She didn't witness any further events.
3. Mr. Brown, the town baker: 'I delivered fresh pastries at 10 pm and left. I heard nothing unusual.' (no alibi provided)
4. Mr. Green, the carpenter: 'I was sawing wood at my shop. I heard the commotion around midnight, but didn't investigate.' (no alibi provided)
